status: qualified component; full goal remains active

api.result: Caller-owned BnModelNativeEngramLayout with sizes, offsets, odd multipliers, rows, head geometry and raw pad token ID.

semantics: Enumerate prime bucket sizes across all Engram tables in configuration order, including nonascending layer order. Validate every configured table row sum before publishing any result.

Portable C11 PCG64 with explicit high/low 64-bit arithmetic, SeedSequence and rejection sampling reproduces NumPy 2.3.5; includes cached 32-bit sampling when the bounded integer range fits. No compiler 128-bit extension.
Metadata-only deterministic query. No payload reads, persistent mutable RNG state, GPU work, token normalization, history or generation admission.
Model adapter requires prepared anatomy and numerics. Original pad token must be mapped before hashing.

reference.cases: Both original real table layouts plus 128 layer seeds x16 draws x2 compressed vocabulary ranges, including repeated cached32-bit draws/rejection. Output preservation on malformed tables, duplicate/out-of-range layers and geometry rejection; nonascending table order.

not_claimed: Native token-map/normalization or carried hash history
Whole Engram/PLE/HCA forward or CLI admission
New ARM/Metal/WASM execution coverage or CUDA kernels
